title: The case-facts REST operation of rwb-case is not in the API Specification or the ownership map
source: API Specification v4 (no case-facts path); Ownership Map v1 (22 REST operations of P3, none of them a reporting feed); legacy RWB-E1-013 section 12 (a Java interface only)
description: The legacy story publishes the case facts through the in-process Java interface CaseReportingApi.caseFacts. Under DP-11 that call becomes a REST contract, but no operation, path, query parameter or response field of that read exists in the API Specification v4, the ownership map or the Architectural v5 extracts. The story therefore declares GET /api/recovery/case/v1/cases/facts on the rwb-case base, with the fields of the legacy interface, and marks the path and the field names provisional.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E1-013 section 12: CaseReportingApi.caseFacts(LocalDate businessDate) with caseId, productGroup, routeCode, stageCode, queueCode, entryDate, stageClockStart, closedDate, status. Ownership Map P3 rows: 22 REST operations, none carrying the facts of a business date.
owner_role: TechX, with the API owner of P3
proposed: Publish the operation on the rwb-case base as GET /api/recovery/case/v1/cases/facts with businessDate, page and size, and confirm it in the API Specification and the Service Contract Catalog at the next revision.

title: The measure-catalog read of rwb-reporting has no path or shape in the sources
source: API Specification v4 (no measure-catalog path); Ownership Map v1 (P9 rows); legacy RWB-E1-013 section 12 (MeasureCatalog.inForce offered by P9)
description: This story consumes the measure definitions in force from rwb-reporting under RWB-P9-E1013-CON so that a version of the age-band list cannot retire a band a definition in force still uses. The legacy interface MeasureCatalog.inForce(LocalDate onDate) is the only evidence of the read; its path, its parameters and its response fields are not in any source.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E1-013 section 12: public interface MeasureCatalog { List<MeasureDefinition> inForce(LocalDate onDate); }. No measure-catalog path in the API Specification v4.
owner_role: TechX, with the API owner of P9 reporting
proposed: Publish the catalog read under RWB-P9-E1013-CON as a GET on the rwb-reporting base with an onDate parameter, and name it in the Service Contract Catalog.

title: The list code and the table code of the age-band reference list are not named
source: Legacy RWB-E1-013 section 8 (BR6, age bands are a reference list) and the Background; reference-data story RWB-P3-E1043-APP (versioned tables, no age-band table code)
description: The five age bands are stated as values, and the story reads them as rows of a versioned reference table of rwb-case with the list read on /admin/lists/{listCode}. Neither the list code used by that read nor the table code of the reference version is named in the legacy story, the FSD P3, the TSD P3 or the ownership map.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E1-013 Background: age bands are "0-90", "91-180", "181-365", "366-730" and "over 730" days since entry. BR6: Age bands are a reference list. No code appears in any source.
owner_role: TechX, with the data steward RW-DATASTEW
proposed: Name the age-band list in the reference-data catalog of RWB-P3-E1043-APP with a list code and a table code, and use that code in this read and on the band list screen.

title: No message is defined for a held facts release, and SCR-44 shows no release state
source: Legacy RWB-E1-013 sections 14 and 15; message catalogue (no message for a held case-fact release); SCR-44 Interface and job monitor
description: The story holds the release of a business date when the facts count differs from the case list count, and lists the case for the data steward. The messages of the legacy story cover the frozen baseline, the incomplete ACE batch and the data lake, but none covers a held release of case facts, and SCR-44 has no defined column set for the release state and the two counts.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E1-013 section 14: MSG-GEN-001, MSG-P9-001, MSG-P1-001, MSG-GEN-006, MSG-P9-003. Section 15: SCR-44 shows the JOB-15 run states running, failed and complete only.
owner_role: TechX, with the data steward RW-DATASTEW
proposed: Add one message for a held facts release to the message catalogue of rwb-case and name the release columns of SCR-44 in the screen specification.
